svg.text: 03 · CHARACTER STYLE TARGET : 2.5D CHIBI ANATOMY & POSES

g.text: 1. Face is large, rounded, and clean — minimum micro-detail.
2. Eyes have distinct double sparkle highlights (top-left & lower-right).
3. Blush cheeks are soft diffused ovals placed under outer eyes.
4. Always grounded by a soft contact shadow (ellipse #663D63 18%).
5. Handheld props snap cleanly into hands at (±47px, 225px).
All 24 wardrobe clothing pieces, 5 hairstyles, and 5 pets align to the same origin (0, 0).
No outfit changes break bounding anchors or cause misalignment during poses.
